scope: Two raster art direction mockups. Participant count, runner identifiers, distance, skill effects and race values are illustrative. Not layered production sprites or implemented Unity UI.

A.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create one exceptionally polished SHIPPING-QUALITY Korean mobile game HUD redesign, portrait 9:16 at 1440 x 2560 or highest supported detail. This is interface design for a Ragnarok-IP mounted character racing game, not a promotional illustration. The attached existing screenshot is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve its underlying 3D race scene, main knight mounted on Peco Peco, competitors, camera perspective and daylight. Replace ALL of its old interface graphics with the design below. Preserve race gameplay visibility and avoid covering faces. Deliver the game screenshot edge-to-edge, no device frame, no presentation board, no outside labels.

ART DIRECTION A: Ragnarok's warm adventure fantasy, premium illustrated mobile RPG craft. Ivory enamel and warm parchment surfaces, deep ink-blue/espresso lettering, restrained burnished brass trim, pale sky-blue glass accents, tiny stylized feather and wing motifs. A pleasant, youthful anime adventure UI. NOT heavy baroque, not dark medieval, not generic website cards. Every button and panel has a deliberate silhouette, polished bevel, inset trim, tiny highlights and a readable hierarchy. Thin scalloped corners and restrained carved motifs at endpoints, never filigree behind text. Bespoke hand-painted game icons, not thin stock outline icons. Crisp large Korean labels. Subtle drop shadows for separation from grass. Frame and interior must look visually separable for later sprite production. Gold is reserved for player marker, rank and skill emphasis.

Use the SAME sample info as the reference, but more elegant hierarchy, less duplicate copy:
1) Upper HUD occupies y=3% to 17% only, left/right margin 4%. Narrow small event caption upper left: "프론테라 초원컵"; small line beneath "잔디 1,600 m". Upper right integrated distance: "남은 거리" small, "420" big, "m" normal. Under that one delicate ivory-and-brass race progress rail, filled 74% with pale aqua, start small flag and finish checkered flag, no huge START/GOAL letters. Under rail a small ordered row of contestant numbers "1 3 6 2 5 8 4 7". All neutral except 3 with gold ring and little MY marker. A small final-corner tag "최종 코너". Do not invent clock, score, gems, health, currencies or stamina.
2) Upper right at y=19% one slim skill notification only: an exquisitely illustrated yellow feather / Peco Peco wing square icon, label "페코페코의 질주", small subline "03 · 내 주자", small effect "속도 ↑". Compact ivory parchment with refined brass edge and a layered blue ribbon accent. Optional small right tail, no stack of notifications. The alert should be subordinate to the race.
3) Small gold down-triangle labeled "MY 03" above/near the main rider, not over the face.
4) Keep all y=29% to 73% mostly free for mounted racing. No additional foreground effects, no new character illustration.
5) Bottom status area y=76% to 88%: elegant asymmetrical guild emblem, not a generic rounded white card. Circular knight portrait on the left slightly overlaps an ivory scroll-shaped name strip; portrait rim has modest metal wings, a tiny "03" ribbon at bottom. Text "기사 · 페코페코", subline "선두와 1.2 m". At right large crafted gold "2" with smaller "위 / 8", small green up-arrow and "+1". Match the character portrait from the scene. A tiny effect feather can appear next to name, but do not repeat skill text.
6) Below it one single unobtrusive dark translucent commentary line: "중계" in small gold then "페코페코, 2위로 올라섭니다!" in legible ivory. No paragraph.
7) Bottom row y=91% to 97%: four beautifully rendered touchable controls, refined enamel/ivory tiles with thin brass frame, subtle raised rim and recessed hand-painted icon. "카메라" with vintage fantasy camera icon, "×1" with double-arrow icon, "건너뛰기" with skip icon, "메뉴" with menu icon. Four controls evenly aligned, at least 44px height at 360-wide scale. Keep labels readable, not ornamental. Small gemstone accents only where natural. No extra bottom nav tabs.

QUALITY BAR: top-tier released mobile fantasy racing UI. Authored game art on buttons, compact deliberate layout, restrained ornament, precise optical alignment and consistent trim thickness. Strong foreground legibility. Avoid pale low-contrast text, huge blank dashboard card, uniform website rectangles, generic Lucide line icons, thick brown wooden frames, giant title logos, excessive sparkles, and busy HUD.
All visible Korean strings exactly as specified. No additional titles A/B or explanatory text.

B.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create one exceptionally polished SHIPPING-QUALITY Korean mobile game HUD redesign, portrait 9:16 at 1440 x 2560 or highest supported detail. This is interface design for the SAME Ragnarok-IP mounted character racing game. The attached screenshot is the EDIT TARGET. Keep the underlying 3D race scene, knight on Peco Peco, all characters, camera, background and sunlight identical. Replace all interface graphic styling with the design below. Retain exactly the same information architecture and UI positions as target so the two versions can be compared fairly. Output edge-to-edge game screenshot only, no mockup device, no board.

ART DIRECTION B: bright contemporary Japanese character-racing game UI comparable in production finish to Uma Musume, with Ragnarok mount identity. Pearl-white surfaces, clear mint/aqua accents, violet-slate lettering, sunny yellow for player/rank. Premium lively sporty game UI. Finely beveled white plastic/enamel frames, neat translucent shadow layers, angled ribbon tabs and clean compact silhouettes. Tiny energetic diagonal speed-stripe accents. Crisp bespoke solid game icons with layered shading, not stock outline icons, not flat SaaS boxes. No parchment, bronze, wood, wing filigree or heavy fantasy frames. This should feel polished, youthful, confident and very legible.

Exact layout and content:
1) Upper HUD y=3%-17%, horizontal margin 4%. Small event caption upper left "프론테라 초원컵", under it "잔디 1,600 m". Upper right small "남은 거리", big "420", small "m". Slim white-enamel progress rail underneath filled 74% with mint gradient. Small start and finish flags, no huge START/GOAL letters. Small ordered contestant numbers below: "1 3 6 2 5 8 4 7"; consistent neutral circles, number 3 yellow ring and little MY marker. Small sporty mint phase tab "최종 코너".
2) Single compact notification upper right at y=19%, illustrated golden feather/Peco Peco wing icon in a mint-accented square. Exact "페코페코의 질주", subline "03 · 내 주자", effect "속도 ↑". White angled speed-strip notification, small bright color accents, subtle highlight. Not stacked notifications.
3) Small yellow down-triangle with "MY 03" above main rider without covering face.
4) Center y=29%-73% stays open for racing, no new artwork, no big effects.
5) Bottom y=76%-88% compact athlete-style status strip: large circular portrait overlaps left edge of a sleek white aerodynamic panel. Portrait rim white and mint with tiny yellow "03" tag. Text "기사 · 페코페코"; subline "선두와 1.2 m". Right side large bold athletic gold "2" with "위 / 8", small mint up-arrow "+1". Tiny feather effect icon beside name if desired, don't repeat skill name. Tight composition with minimal wasted space, no giant white dashboard card. Angled tab shapes and subtle aqua stripe.
6) One narrow dark translucent commentary line below: small "중계", followed by "페코페코, 2위로 올라섭니다!".
7) Bottom row y=91%-97% four evenly aligned generous touch controls: "카메라" camera icon, "×1" double arrows, "건너뛰기" skip icon, "메뉴" menu icon. Bright pearl-white button shells, lavender-slate glyphs and text, mint selected accent on camera, tight 3D bevel and subtle lavender shadows. At least 44px touch height at 360-wide size. All Korean type crisp and bold.

QUALITY: a polished launched mobile game screenshot; elegant sporty typography, precise alignment, compact UI with jewel-like clarity. Preserve original race art exactly. Avoid web dashboard look, default rounded HTML buttons, thin generic outline icons, overly huge controls, tiny grey text, broad empty panels, arbitrary extra gauges, and fake game currencies.
No title B, no external annotations, no watermark. Exact Korean strings.
